column1: # macOS preference groups applied by bootstrap.sh.
# Types are bool, int, float and string. `$HOME` in a value is expanded.
# A group is applied only when its `macos:<group>` item is selected.
# Keep this list small and reversible: --revert-macos restores the value
# recorded before the first change. Settings that need sudo, change security
# posture, or depend on optional hardware do not belong here.
